usedFor: Crystal Ball marks events on your analytics with “Create Annotation in Crystal Ball”, “Change Annotation” and “Delete Annotation”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Clock In” in Jibble, then “Create Annotation in Crystal Ball” in Crystal Ball
bestTemplate.why: The action adds an annotation for an event, so a clock in becomes a note beside your numbers.

watchOut: “Delete Annotation” removes an annotation from your account, so check which event it points at.
